name: zvec_grep_search
description: Search an existing zvec-grep index of the workspace: hybrid lexical (BM25) + vector retrieval for semantic, fuzzy, relationship, and cross-file questions whose wording or location is unknown. Use the built-in Grep/Glob instead for exact words, names, paths, keys, and regexes. Results are a ranked sample with file:line anchors, so follow up with Read or Grep. The index is workspace-scoped and user-managed: never build, rebuild, or delete it yourself; report a missing index and let the user run /zg-index.
snippet: Ranked hybrid (lexical + vector) search over a local zvec-grep index.

fts.description: Ranked lexical query groups inside the index; not exhaustive occurrence lookup.

fuse.description: Fuse every query group into one ranked plan.

preview.description: short (default) keeps a bounded snippet per hit; full adds the complete content and outline.

freshness.description: wait_for_fresh (default) refreshes changed files before searching; eventual answers immediately and marks stale items.

root.description: Absolute workspace root; defaults to the session working directory.

globs.description: Ordered path rules, e.g. src/** or !**/dist/**.

fileTypes.description: ripgrep file types, e.g. ts or md.

ignoreFiles.description: Extra ignore files relative to the root.

symbolTypes.description: Restrict results to these symbol types.

modifiedAfter.description: Only files modified after this ISO date or epoch milliseconds.

modifiedBefore.description: Only files modified before this ISO date or epoch milliseconds.
